data.rationale: The proposal has the right general shape (destination, dates, search, then filters) but targets the wrong site flow (Booking.com instead of the Qatar Airways Book > Hotels flow), omits the sort-by-price step, and adds guest and filter steps that weren't in the actual occurrence, so it is only partly usable as an automation spec.
